items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron, saying,
items.claim: The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron

items.quote: he shall be brought unto Aaron the priest, or unto one of his sons the priests:
items.claim: A man with potential plague symptoms shall be brought to Aaron the priest or one of his sons

items.quote: And the priest shall look on the plague in the skin of the flesh:
items.claim: The priest shall look upon the plague in the skin
items.place: in the skin of the flesh

items.quote: and the priest shall look on him, and pronounce him unclean.
items.claim: The priest shall pronounce him unclean
